title: Shashwat Sachdev, Jubin Nautiyal  and  Irshad Kamil - Aakhri Ishq (From Dhurandhar The Revenge)

lines.l: I am with you, I am with you
If I were not, then what happened?
I have the love that I was not
If I were not, then what happened?
I am the last, I am the last, I am the last, I am the last
I will not be able to meet my life, I will not be able to meet my life
Is it true or is it true or is it true?
I don't want to, so what has happened?
You have the love that I don't want to,
I am the last, I am the last love that I don't want to
